evaluation_criteria.notes: Review up to 20 Bank documents, workforce datasets, conduct 15 stakeholder interviews (60 minutes each), one 3-hour validation session, assess workforce planning practices, and develop workforce planning assessment.

source_refs.excerpt: Specs - Discovery and assessment: Assume: Review up to twenty (20) Bank documents, including workforce data, HR reports, planning documents, and organizational information; Review workforce datasets, including demographics, movement trends, vacancies, retirement eligibility, workforce planning metrics, and related indicators; Conduct fifteen (15) stakeholder interviews of sixty (60) minutes each with HR and senior business leaders on workforce priorities, risks, succession, talent needs, and future capabilities; Conduct one (1) three-hour stakeholder validation session to review findings, validate observations, and discuss priority workforce planning considerations; Assess current workforce planning practices, workforce risks, and workforce-related challenges; Identify current and future workforce capability requirements; and Develop a workforce planning assessment summarizing key findings, risks, opportunities, and observations.

evaluation_criteria.title: Discovery and assessment

evaluation_criteria.notes: Analyze information gathered, identify critical workforce risks and challenges, develop recommendations on workforce planning and talent sustainability, identify implementation considerations, and develop prioritized implementation roadmap.
